findings.symptom: The source-authored stencil drawing is rendered as a red “diagram failed to render” error block in the standalone original-resolution tile and frozen HTML. The error block itself is horizontally scrollable in HTML and preserves the TikZ source; the diagram is unavailable as a rendered visual.
findings.mathematical_content: Three contiguous control volumes labelled U_{j-1}^n, U_j^n, U_{j+1}^n; two rightward arrows and corresponding shared-face fluxes F(U_{j-1}^n,U_j^n) and F(U_j^n,U_{j+1}^n); the center-cell update U_j^{n+1}=U_j^n-λ(right flux-left flux). The boxes, face locations, arrow directions, labels and sign order agree with the shared-flux update at source lines 52–59. No mathematical defect in the intended schematic was found.
findings.renderer_diagnostic: Receipt says diagram failed and embeds the full failed TikZ string; it supplies no underlying parser diagnostic.

existing_diagram_checks.visual_checks: Every receipt-listed screenshot tile was opened individually via view_image(detail="original"). Authored diagram mathematics was checked against its exact source relation where present.
existing_diagram_checks.result: The failed finite-volume stencil and the correctly rendered nonmonotone shock schematic were the only TikZ drawings in lane 10. Their mathematical relations/orientations agree with source. No additional missing diagram is sufficiently warranted as a concrete omission defect.

review_summary.notes: Review is bound to the frozen assignment, complete frozen snapshots/ItemBody ranges, assigned HTML, receipt metadata and each original-resolution tile hash. Long expressions that appear close to a tile edge were not called clipping absent evidence that the assigned HTML made source content inaccessible. No parser/frontmatter blocker in frontmatter-parse-blockers.json applies to assigned lane 10; metadata blocker records remain categorically separate.

limitations: Read-only frozen local files only. No HTTP(S), live site, network, production source edits, native publication changes, tests, builds, gates, or Git operations were performed.
Mathematical review is limited to rendered formulas/diagrams and whether diagrams are concretely warranted; no general proof audit was performed.
